verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Files API for creating, reading, editing, moving and deleting files, and plan pages list windows for restoring deleted files (30 days, 180 days, 1 year). Nothing in the pack documents API endpoints for listing file revisions or restoring a prior version. The retention windows are plan-level restore periods for deleted files, not documented API version-history behavior, so the core of the story is unevidenced.
